rank.basis: Unmarked Love Hashira: exceptional muscle density, flexible Love Breathing Nichirin sword, fast and precise cutting of Zohakuten's wooden dragon attacks before the Slayer Mark appears. She is an elite Hashira combatant.
rank.limits: The early encounter with Zohakuten shows her vulnerability to compressed sound and does not establish prolonged survival without the Demon Slayer Mark. Later marked feats must remain a separately illustrated and ranked form.
